name: Topology and Shape Optimization
description: Overview and historical context, design problems in structural optimization: sizing, shape, and topology, linear elasticity review: stress, strain, constitutive laws, finite element method (FEM) basics for structural analysis, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) basics for flow analysis, general problem statement, design domain, objective functions, constraints: volume, stress, hydrodynamic performance, compliance, manufacturing, SIMP method (solid isotropic material with penalization), gradient-based optimization: MMA, OC method, filtering and regularization techniques, level set methods for topology optimization, phase-field and other implicit methods, topology optimization beyond linear elasticity, parametric and non-parametric shape optimization.
